blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spike cameras capture high-speed motion through an integrate-and-fire mechanism, providing fine-grained temporal observations without exposure blur. However, their binary streams encode accumulated illumination rather than instantaneous intensity, making reliable motion estimation challenging. Existing spike-based methods exploit temporal aggregation to construct motion representations, but this process may weaken fine-grained firing patterns. Meanwhile, correlation-based estimators often rely on learned matching features without explicitly characterizing the spatial distribution and ambiguity of candidate displacements. To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow, a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE). TIE combines raw spike patterns, multi-scale firing statistics, temporal moments, and boundary-aware interval cues, preserving complementary temporal information before spatial feature compression. DEE further integrates structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize matching geometry and competing correspondences. Both components are incorporated into a difference-correlation recurrent refinement framework, enabling effective temporal motion modeling and correspondence estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, with controlled ablations validating the contributions of temporal and displacement evidence modeling.
blocks.zh: 斯派克相机通过集成相和相火机制来捕捉高速运动,提供细纹的时间观测而不会暴露模糊. 然而,它们的二进制流编码积累了照明而不是瞬间强度,使得可靠的运动估计具有挑战性. 现有的以扑克为基础的方法利用时间聚合来构建运动表达,但这一过程可能会削弱精细的射出模式. 同时,基于相关性的估算往往依赖所学到的匹配特征,而没有明确描述候选人员迁移的空间分布和模糊性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用以 " 花 " 为基点的光学流估计框架,共同利用 " 时间综合证据 " 和 " 流离失所证据编码 " 。 TIE结合了原始的悬崖图案,多尺度的起火统计,时间瞬间,和边界意识间隔提示,在空间特征压缩前保留了互补的时间信息. DEE进一步将结构化的候选网格特征与明确的流离失所统计数据相融合,以描述匹配的几何和相竞的通信特征. 这两个组成部分都被纳入了差异关系经常性完善框架,从而能够有效进行时间运动模型和函证估计。 广泛的实验证明TIDE-Flow的有效性,有控制的活化验证了时间和迁移证据模型的建模作用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Optical flow estimates pixel-wise motion and plays a fundamental role in dynamic scene understanding. Despite substantial advances in frame-based methods [ 7 , 22 , 23 , 28 ] , high-speed motion remains challenging due to exposure-induced blur and limited temporal sampling. Neuromorphic sensors offer an alternative sensing paradigm. Unlike event cameras that respond to changes in logarithmic intensity [ 8 ] , spike cameras integrate incident light and emit binary spikes upon reaching a threshold. These integrate-and-fire mechanisms provide fine temporal resolution and encode scene intensity through firing activity, but individual spikes do not directly represent instantaneous image intensities [ 11 , 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 光学流估计出像素相向运动,并在动态场景理解中起根本作用. 尽管在以帧为基础的方法[7、22、23、28]方面取得了实质性进展,但由于暴露引起的模糊和有限的时间取样,高速运动仍然具有挑战性。 神经形态传感器提供了一个替代的感知范式。 与响应对数强度变化的事件相机不同 [8],突起相机融合出事件光并到达阈值后会放出二进制相机. 这些集成相和相火机制通过起火活动提供了精细的时间解析度并编码了场景强度,但单个的突起并不直接代表瞬间图像强度[11,36].

blocks.en: Estimating optical flow from spikes therefore requires motion representations adapted to their sensing characteristics. Existing methods have explored temporal sampling, firing-time intervals, spatiotemporal fusion, and motion aggregation [ 35 , 34 , 29 ] . Related spike reconstruction studies have also investigated temporal aggregation across different scales [ 6 ] . However, temporal aggregation and spatial compression may weaken fine-grained firing-time cues. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), distinct spike patterns can produce identical firing rates, indicating that aggregated statistics cannot fully preserve their temporal configurations. Meanwhile, correlation-based flow estimators rely on learned matching features for correspondence reasoning [ 23 , 13 ] . Their local correlation distributions may contain competing candidates with similar scores but different displacement offsets, as shown in Fig. 1 (b). Although learned cost encoders can capture matching patterns [ 30 , 20 ] , the spatial arrangement and distribution statistics of candidate displacements are not always explicitly represented. These observations highlight two complementary challenges: preserving informative spike timing and interpreting displacement evidence.
blocks.zh: 因此,要估计从尖端光学流出的情况,需要有适应其感知特性的运动表现。 现有方法探索了时间取样、发火时间间隔、瞬间聚变和运动聚合[35、34、29]。 相关的 " 高峰 " 重建研究也调查了不同尺度的时间汇总。 然而,时间聚合和空间压缩可能会削弱精细的发射时间提示. 如图1(a)所示,明显的猛增模式可以产生相同的发火率,这表明汇总统计数据无法充分保持其时间配置。 同时,基于相关性的流量估计器依赖所学到的匹配特征进行函证推理[23,13]. 如图1(b)所示,它们的当地关联分布可能包含得分相近但流离失所情况不同的竞争候选人。 虽然所学成本编码器能够捕捉匹配模式[30,20],但候选人迁移的空间安排和分布统计并不总是明确体现. 这些意见突出说明了两个相辅相成的挑战:保留提供信息的激增时间和解释流离失所的证据。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose TIDE-Flow , a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that jointly exploits Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) and Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE) . First, TIE aims to explicitly preserve fine-grained firing information before spatial feature compression. It combines raw binary patterns, multi-scale firing rates, and a temporal first moment to retain complementary timing cues. Furthermore, boundary-aware inter-spike interval cues distinguish complete integration intervals from partially observed ones, providing additional information about the underlying firing process. To preserve local spatial organization, TIE rearranges neighboring spike measurements into separate channels before learned feature reduction. This enables the network to jointly exploit detailed firing configurations and complementary temporal statistics for distinct motion representation.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用以 " 突起 " 为主的光学流动估算框架,共同利用 " 临时综合证据 " 和 " 流离失所证据编码 " 。 首先,TIE的目的是在空间特征压缩之前明确保存精细的射击信息. 它结合了原始的二进制模式,多尺度的发火率,以及保留互补计时提示的一时一时. 此外,了解边界的相交间隔提示将完全的集成间隔与部分被观测到的集成间隔区分开来,从而就基本的发火过程提供更多信息。 为了保持当地的空间组织,TIE在吸取知识的特征减少之前,将相邻的悬崖测量重新排列成单独的通道. 这使该网络能够联合利用详细的发射配置和补充时间统计数据,以进行不同的运动表现。

blocks.en: Second, DEE improves how local correspondence evidence is encoded during optical flow estimation. DEE arranges the sampled correlations on a two-dimensional grid of candidate offsets and encodes their local structure. It further introduces explicit displacement statistics, including candidate locations, spatial dispersion, and peak-related measurements, to characterize the concentration and competition of plausible correspondences. These learned and explicit representations provide complementary geometric evidence for subsequent flow refinement. TIDE-Flow integrates TIE-based temporal features and DEE-based displacement features into recurrent motion estimation, enabling both forms of evidence to guide iterative flow updates.
blocks.zh: 第二,DEE改进了光学流估计过程中本地函证编码的方式. DEE在二维网格上安排候选人相抵的样本关联,并编码其本地结构. 它还引入了明确的流离失所统计数据,包括候选地点、空间分散和与高峰有关的测量,以描述可信通信的集中和竞争。 这些学到的和明确的表述为随后的流量改进提供了补充的几何证据. TIDE-Flow将基于TIE的时间特征和基于DEE的迁移特征纳入经常性运动估计,使两种形式的证据都能够指导迭代流更新.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold. • We propose Temporal Integration Evidence (TIE) to preserve fine-grained spike timing through joint modeling of firing patterns, multi-scale statistics, and boundary-aware interval cues before spatial compression. • We develop Displacement Evidence Encoding (DEE) to enhance correspondence reasoning by combining structured candidate-grid features with explicit statistics of displacement geometry and matching ambiguity. • Extensive experiments on synthetic and real spike data demonstrate the effectiveness of TIDE-Flow, achieving competitive optical flow accuracy while striking a better balance between accuracy, model size, and computation.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献有三。 我们提议,在空间压缩之前,通过联合模拟射击模式、多尺度统计和边界识别间隔提示,保持精确的悬崖时间。 我们开发了流离失所证据编码(DEE),通过将结构化的候选网格特征与流离失所几何和相匹配的模糊性的明确统计数据相结合,加强函证推理。 · 合成和真实悬浮数据的广泛试验表明,TIDE-Flow是有效的,实现了具有竞争力的光学流精度,同时在精确度、模型大小和计算之间取得了更好的平衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Spike Camera Optical Flow
blocks.zh: 2.1 Spike相机光学流

blocks.en: Spike cameras encode accumulated illumination through binary firing streams, whose temporal characteristics and firing fluctuations have been studied in spike imaging [ 38 , 37 ] . SCFlow [ 11 ] introduced motion-guided temporal sampling, while Spike2Flow [ 36 ] exploited differential spike firing time (DSFT) and correlation matching. Subsequent methods investigated self-supervised flow estimation [ 3 ] , hierarchical spatiotemporal fusion [ 35 ] , dual-DSFT motion modeling [ 34 ] , and direction-disassembled refinement [ 29 ] . Related reconstruction methods further explored temporal correlations and motion-aware aggregation [ 33 , 5 , 6 ] . TIDE-Flow organizes raw firing patterns, multi-scale statistics, and boundary-aware interval evidence before spatial compression, while incorporating structured displacement modeling for correspondence estimation.
blocks.zh: 斯派克相机编码通过二进制放电流积累出发光,其时间特征和发光起伏被研究于斯派克成像[38,37]. SCFlow [11]引入了运动制导时间采样,而Spike2Flow [36] 则利用了差分尖点发火时间(DSFT)和相通相配. 随后的方法调查了自我监督的流量估计[3],分级分层分层聚变[35],双DSFT运动模型[34],并有方向分解的精细化[29]. 相关的重建方法进一步探讨了时间相关性和运动意识聚合[33、5、6]。 TIDE-Flow在空间压缩前组织原始发火模式,多尺度统计,以及边界认知间隔证据,同时将结构化的置换模型用于函证估计.

blocks.en: 2.2 Event-based Optical Flow
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于事件的光学流动

blocks.en: Unlike spike cameras, event cameras measure changes in logarithmic intensity without absolute intensity. Early methods developed event-specific representations and learning objectives [ 39 , 40 ] . E-RAFT [ 9 ] introduced dense correlation and recurrent refinement, followed by advances in temporal aggregation [ 16 , 19 ] , continuous-time estimation [ 24 , 10 , 12 ] , and efficient flow modeling [ 18 ] . Recent approaches further explored unified matching [ 31 ] , dense temporal differences [ 15 ] , and adaptive temporal correlation [ 26 ] . Building on recurrent difference-correlation refinement, TIDE-Flow addresses the integrate-and-fire characteristics of spike cameras through fine-grained temporal evidence and structured displacement encoding.
blocks.zh: 与悬崖相机不同,事件相机测量对数强度的变化时没有绝对强度. 早期方法制定了针对具体事件的表述和学习目标[39,40]. E-RAFT[9]引入了密集的关联性和经常性的完善,随后在时间汇总[16,19],连续时间估计[24,10,12],高效流量模型[18]等方面取得进展. 最近的方针进一步探索了统一匹配[31],密集的时间差异[15],以及适应时间相关性[26]. 在反复出现的差异-血缘关系改进的基础上,TIDE-Flow通过精细的时间证据和结构化的迁移编码,解决了悬索相机的集成和火力特性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Correspondence and Matching-Cost Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.3 通信和匹配-成本模型

blocks.en: Optical flow estimation has progressed from pyramid-based cost volumes [ 22 ] to recurrent all-pairs matching [ 23 , 25 ] . Subsequent methods improved correspondence reasoning through global aggregation [ 14 ] , neighborhood affinity [ 17 ] , structured cost modeling [ 30 ] , and transformer-based matching [ 28 , 13 , 21 , 20 ] . Recent studies also explored efficient correlation sampling [ 2 ] and temporal memory [ 4 ] . DEE combines learned patterns on the sampled candidate grid with geometric moments and peak statistics to characterize competing correspondences.
blocks.zh: 光学流量估计已从以金字塔为基础的成本量[22]发展到与[23,25]相匹配的经常性全平面. 随后的方法通过全球汇总[14],邻里亲和[17],结构化成本模型[30],以及基于变压器的匹配[28,13,21,20],改进了函证推理. 最近的研究还探讨了高效的关联抽样[2]和时间记忆[4]。 DEE将所抽样候选网格上的所学模式与几何瞬间和峰值统计相结合,以描述相竞争的函文特征.

Their outputs are fused to update the optical flow iteratively, with each prediction guiding the subsequent temporal alignment and correspondence lookup.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: Following prior spike-based optical flow studies [ 35 , 34 ] , we train on SPIFT and evaluate on PHM, both introduced by SCFlow [ 11 ] . SPIFT contains 100 training and 10 validation sequences (50K and 5K samples), while PHM comprises multiple photorealistic scenes with challenging motions, including rotation, collision, and camera movement. Both datasets provide simulated spike streams and dense ground-truth flow. Following the established evaluation protocol [ 11 , 36 ] , we evaluate at Δ ​ t ∈ { 10 , 20 } \Delta t\in\left\{10,20\right\} to assess different motion magnitudes. We further conduct qualitative evaluations on real high-speed spike recordings.

We evaluate optical flow using Average End-Point Error (AEPE) [ 1 ] and Percentage of Outliers (PO%) [ 36 , 35 ] . AEPE measures the mean endpoint error, while PO% measures the fraction of pixels with errors exceeding both 0.5 pixels and 5% of the ground-truth flow magnitude [ 36 ] . Lower is better for both metrics.

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparative Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.1 比较实验

blocks.en: We compare TIDE-Flow with representative methods on the PHM [ 11 ] and real spike recordings. The compared methods are grouped into three categories: (1) spike-based methods, including SCFlow [ 11 ] , HiST-SFlow [ 35 ] , Spike2Flow [ 36 ] , Spike2Flow++ [ 34 ] , and SIV [ 32 ] ; (2) event-based methods, including EMatch [ 31 ] , EEMFlow+ [ 18 ] , and EDCFlow [ 15 ] ; and (3) conventional frame-based optical flow methods, including RAFT [ 23 ] , Flow1D [ 27 ] , KPA-Flow [ 17 ] , CRAFT [ 21 ] , and FlowFormer [ 13 ] . For fair comparison, all methods are evaluated in the same experimental setting under identical evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们把TIDE-Flow 与PHM[11]上的代表性方法以及真实的悬赏录音进行比较. 比较方法分为三类:(1) 以悬赏法为基础的方法,包括SCFlow [11],HiST-SFlow [35],Spike2 Flow [36],Spike2 Flow++ [34],和SIV [32]; (2)基于事件的方法,包括EMatch [31],EEMFlow+ [18],和EDCFlow [15];和 (3)基于常规帧的光学流法,包括RAFT [23],Flow1D [27],KPA-Flow [17],CRAFT [21],和FlowFormer [13]. 为了进行公平比较,所有方法都在同一试验环境中根据相同的评价协议进行评价。

blocks.en: Tab. 1 presents the quantitative results on the PHM benchmark [ 11 ] under two temporal intervals, Δ ​ t = 10 \Delta t=10 and Δ ​ t = 20 \Delta t=20 . For Δ ​ t = 10 \Delta t=10 , TIDE-Flow achieves the best average AEPE of 0.584 and PO% of 13.21, reducing the errors by 5.8% and 6.4%, respectively, compared with Spike2Flow++. Notably, our method achieves leading performance on several challenging scenes, including Dice, Doll, Fan, and Jump, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse motion patterns. When the temporal interval increases to Δ ​ t = 20 \Delta t=20 , TIDE-Flow maintains competitive accuracy, achieving an AEPE of 1.241 and the lowest PO% of 16.75. Compared with Spike2Flow++, it achieves a comparable AEPE while reducing PO% from 18.11 to 16.75. These results indicate that TIDE-Flow provides accurate motion estimation while effectively reducing large displacement errors, particularly under increased temporal separation.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1在两个时间间隔下介绍了PHM基准[11]的定量结果,QQ t = 10\Delta t = 10和QQ t = 20\Delta t = 20. 对于QQ t = 10\Delta t = 10,TIDE-Flow实现0.584和13.21的PO%的最佳平均APE,相较于Spike2Flow+,错误分别减少5.8%和6.4%. 值得注意的是,我们的方法在包括Dice、Doll、Fan和Jump在内的几个具有挑战性的场景上取得了领先的性能,显示了它在不同运动模式中的效力。 当时间间隔提升到QQ t = 20\Delta t = 20时,TIDE-Flow保持了竞争精度,实现了1.241的APE和16.75的最低PO%. 与斯派克2Flow++相比,它实现了一个相类似的AEPE,同时将PO%从18.11降至16.75. 这些结果表明,TIDE-Flow提供了准确的运动估计,同时有效地减少了巨大的迁移错误,特别是在时间分离增加的情况下.

blocks.en: Tab. 2 further compares the model complexity and inference efficiency at a resolution of 500 × 800 500\times 800 . TIDE-Flow achieves the lowest computational cost among the compared methods, requiring only 2.519M parameters, 692.0G MACs, and 168.7 ms per inference. Compared with Spike2Flow++, our method reduces the parameter count by 70.9%, MACs by 43.1%, and inference time by 25.6%, while achieving better average PO% under both temporal intervals. These results demonstrate that TIDE-Flow achieves a favorable balance between optical flow accuracy and computational efficiency.

Comparing (A) and (B), introducing TIE reduces AEPE by 6.31% and 5.38% for Δ ​ t = 10 \Delta t=10 and Δ ​ t = 20 \Delta t=20 , respectively, demonstrating the benefit of preserving temporal integration evidence. Further incorporating DEE in (D) improves AEPE under both intervals, indicating the effectiveness of encoding displacement-aware matching information. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose TIDE-Flow , a spike-based optical flow estimation framework that addresses the loss of fine-grained firing-time information and ambiguity in displacement matching. TIE preserves raw spike patterns, multi-scale temporal statistics, and boundary-aware interval cues before spatial compression, enabling more informative motion representations. DEE combines structured candidate-grid features with explicit displacement statistics to characterize competing correspondences, providing complementary geometric evidence for recurrent flow refinement. The PHM ablations quantify the contributions of both representations, and the full model achieves the lowest outlier rate in the main comparison at both temporal intervals.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用以 " 花 " 为基点的光学流动估算框架,处理丢失精细的射击时间信息和流离失所匹配中的模糊问题。 TIE在空间压缩前保留了原始的悬崖图案,多尺度的时间统计,以及边界意识间隔提示,使得能够进行更多的信息化的运动表达. DEE将结构化的候选网格特征与明确的流离失所统计数据结合起来,以描述相互竞争的通信,为经常性的流量改进提供补充几何证据。 PHM分数量化了两种表达方式的贡献,完整的模型在两次时间间隔的主要比较中实现了最低的出差率.
